selection: Every train task with audited eligible preferred response and fewer than min(2,unique preferred responses) existing teacher pairs. Preserve teacher production order. No eval/test tasks.
estimate_source: Measured control generation seconds per response times planned response count; forecast only, different task mix and lengths.
quality: Only verified numeric/unit errors qualify; unparsed outputs excluded. No synthetic corruptions, reused pairs or quantity inflation. Correct supplemental responses are not added to SFT.
